title: Graphic Designer
description:
**We’re building a brand that connects with students globally, and we believe great design plays a key role in creating meaningful connections. From engaging social media creatives to digital campaigns, we’re always exploring new ideas, creative styles, and AI-powered tools to make our brand stand out.**

**About the Role**

**Are you someone who loves experimenting with visuals, exploring new design trends, and turning ideas into eye-catching creatives?**

**We’re looking for a Graphic Design Intern who is creative, curious, and excited to work on real-world projects. You’ll help shape the visual identity of Acolyte Living across social media and digital platforms while exploring the possibilities of AI in design.**

**Roles & Responsibilities**

**\* Design social media posts, carousels, banners, advertisements, and marketing creatives.**

**\* Work with Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, and other Adobe Creative Suite tools.**

**\* Use AI tools such as ChatGPT and Adobe Firefly to explore concepts and create visual assets.**

**\* Create engaging designs aligned with brand guidelines and campaign objectives.**

**\* Edit images, experiment with layouts, and develop creative visual concepts.**

**\* Research design trends and bring fresh ideas to marketing campaigns.**

**\* Assist with basic UI/UX design tasks for websites and landing pages, as required.**

**\* Incorporate feedback and refine designs to meet project requirements.**

**Skills Required**

**\* Basic knowledge of Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator.**

**\* Familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite.**

**\* Interest in AI-powered design tools and creative workflows.**

**\* Understanding of typography, color theory, composition, and layouts.**

**\* Basic knowledge of Figma or UI/UX design is an added advantage.**

**\* Creativity, attention to detail, and a willingness to experiment and learn.**

**Who Should Apply?**

**\* Freshers, students, and aspiring graphic designers.**

**\* Candidates who enjoy creating digital content and visual storytelling.**

**\* Individuals interested in combining traditional design skills with AI tools.**

**\* Applicants with a portfolio, personal projects, or sample designs.**

**What You’ll Gain**

**\* Hands-on experience working on real marketing campaigns.**

**\* Exposure to digital branding and international student-focused marketing.**

**\* Opportunities to experiment with AI-assisted design workflows.**

**\* Practical experience to strengthen your design portfolio.**

**\* A collaborative environment where creativity, ideas, and learning are encouraged.**

**How to Apply**

**Send us your resume along with your portfolio or sample design work.**

Work Location: In person

title: Learning Experience Designer and Developer
description:
Join our team and you will have the opportunity to work in a collaborative and inclusive environment. Our Capability and Development team empowers our people through continuous learning, impactful leadership development, and tailored capability strategies.

We are a global financial services group operating in 30 markets with 57 years of unbroken profitability. At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that is fulfilling and creates value. You will bring your insights and expertise to the task at hand and feel supported as you make your own kind of impact for a better future.

### **What role will you play?**

The role focuses on partnering with L&D teams, subject matter experts, and business stakeholders to identify capability needs and design effective, learner-centred solutions. This includes translating business requirements into learning objectives, learner journeys, project plans, and delivery timelines.The individual will design and develop blended learning solutions across digital learning, virtual sessions, microlearning, videos, simulations, assessments, and job aids, using tools such as Articulate Storyline, Rise 360, and Adobe Creative Cloud. They will also create supporting materials including storyboards, scripts, facilitator guides, and learner resources.

### **What you offer**

* Advanced proficiency in Articulate Storyline and Rise 360, with experience in Adobe Creative Cloud and other digital learning technologies.
* This is an individual contributor role requiring 5+ years of experience in learning experience design and digital learning development
* Strong digital learning development skills, including multimedia, interaction design, responsive learning, assessments, and quality assurance.
* Good understanding of adult-learning principles and instructional design methodologies, including ADDIE, SAM, and agile/iterative approaches.
* Strong learning solution design capability, with the ability to translate business and performance needs into effective blended learning experiences.
* Excellent content writing, storyboarding, and scripting skills, with the ability to simplify complex information into clear and engaging content.
* Strong knowledge of digital accessibility standards, assessment design, learner experience, and quality testing.
* Effective stakeholder and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, collaborate across teams, and leverage AI and emerging learning technologies responsibly.

We love hearing from anyone inspired to build a better future with us, if you're excited about the role or working at Macquarie we encourage you to apply.

### **What we offer**

At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that’s rewarding in all the ways that matter most to you. Macquarie employees can access a wide range of benefits which, depending on eligibility criteria, include:

  
  

* 1 wellbeing leave day per year
* 26 weeks’ paid maternity leave or 20 weeks’ paid parental leave for primary caregivers along with 12 days of paid transition leave upon return to work and 6 weeks’ paid leave for secondary caregivers
* Company-subsidised childcare services
* 2 days of paid volunteer leave and donation matching
* Benefits to support your physical, mental and financial wellbeing including comprehensive medical and life insurance cover, the option to join parental medical insurance plan and virtual medical consultations extended to family members
* Access to our Employee Assistance Program, a robust behavioural health network with counselling and coaching services
* Access to a wide range of learning and development opportunities, including reimbursement for professional membership or subscription
* Hybrid and flexible working arrangements, dependent on role
* Reimbursement for work from home equipment

### **About Financial Management, People and Engagement**

Financial Management, People and Engagement (FPE) provides a single interface for Macquarie’s businesses across key areas of people, strategy, communications and financial management. Comprising two pillars – Financial Management, and People and Engagement – it is responsible for managing the Group’s financial, tax and treasury activities and strategic priorities, fostering our culture through people and community engagement strategies, and engaging with stakeholders to protect and promote Macquarie’s reputation globally.

### **Inclusion at Macquarie**

We are committed to providing an inclusive environment for all, where different experiences, skills and perspectives are valued and respected. Macquarie provides access to opportunities for all individuals regardless of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, marital status, gender identity or any other characteristic or circumstance.  

We provide reasonable adjustments to individuals who may need support during the recruitment process and employment. If you require an adjustment, please let us know during the application process.

title: Principal UX/CX Designer - Multiple Locations
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

The Enterprise Digital Product Office (EDPO) at Optum is a centralized organization focused on accelerating digital transformation across the enterprise. The team partners across business, technology, and operations to design, build, and scale product-centric solutions that improve customer experiences, optimize operational workflows, and deliver measurable business outcomes. The team drives consistency in product strategy, agile delivery, and design practices, enabling teams to operate with greater speed, clarity, and impact. By aligning cross-functional stakeholders and leveraging modern technologies, including cloud platforms, data, and AI, the organization supports the development of scalable, user-centered solutions that help advance Optum's mission to build a more effective and equitable health care system.

As a Principal UX/CX Designer, you'll define the experience strategy for complex products while remaining deeply involved in the hands-on design work that brings those experiences to life. You'll partner with leaders across product, engineering, research, and business to solve the organization's most challenging design problems, guide other designers, and influence product direction through both strategic thinking and exceptional design craft.

This role is ideal for a designer who enjoys shaping vision while staying close to the work, leading through influence, mentoring others, and raising the quality of design across the organization.

**Strategic focus:** 35% strategic, 65% tactical

This position is a hybrid role.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Partner with the Enterprise digital product team on optum.com, and other Optum sites as needed
* Create user flows, wireframes, journey maps, and information architecture artifacts
* Explore emerging opportunities in the digital healthcare space, evaluate and evangelize as needed
* Interpret insights (analytics, VoC, market feedback etc.) to anticipate user needs and proactively design innovative solutions
* Drive discovery activities, synthesize research and analytics, and translate insights into innovative, user-centered product experiences
* Build alignment across cross-functional teams by clearly communicating design rationale, facilitating discussions, and influencing strategic product decisions
* Continually advocate for the user and ensure there is a shared understanding of the problems we are solving (Be the voice of the user in prioritization, new products and features)
* Partner with research and content teams to ensure alignment across user needs, messaging, and experience design
* Lead discussion and critique of work, solicit requirements from stakeholders, and be a key partner in helping deliver on our mission
* Serve as a key resource on complex and/or critical issues
* Actively engage in the team culture and contribute to learning and presentation opportunities across the design organization
* Lead by example through exceptional design execution while establishing a high bar for quality, craft, and attention to detail
* Anticipate customer needs and proactively develop solutions
* Provide design recommendations based on technical feasibility, usability findings, A11y, legal and design best practices
* Maintain a design culture of simple, seamless, and intuitive user experiences
* Review work performed by others and provide recommendations for improvement
* Authorize deviations from current standards based on analytics or evidence-based observations
* Advance the design system, reusable patterns, and design best practices to improve consistency, efficiency, and scalability across products
* Motivate and inspire other team members
* Lead UX strategy across large-scale journeys, platforms, or ecosystems
* Own and evolve information architecture, navigation models, and site structures
* Facilitate alignment across cross-functional teams to define and deliver cohesive end-to-end experiences
* Translate research, data, and business needs into clear experience strategies and design direction
* Partner closely with engineering throughout implementation to ensure the final product reflects the intended experience through ongoing design reviews and quality assurance
* Leverage AI-enabled tools responsibly to accelerate research, ideation, documentation, and design workflows while identifying new opportunities to improve team effectiveness and product experiences
* Elevate experience quality through critique, coaching, and structured design approaches
* Navigate ambiguity and structure complex problem spaces into clear, actionable solutions
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so

**Required Qualifications:**

* Undergraduate degree or equivalent experience
* 10+ years of hands-on experience with UX design, including information architecture and journey design
* 10+ years of experience working with multiple teams and competing priorities
* 10+ years of experience incorporating user feedback in the design process (user research, NPS, Voice of the customer)
* 10+ years of experience with prominent industry design tools (Figma, Figjam, Figma Make, Adobe Creative Suite)
* 5+ years of experience working in cross functional teams
* 5+ years of experience building and/or utilizing personas to inform design decisions
* 5+ years of experience presenting to stakeholders
* Proven experience leading UX strategy across complex or large-scale digital experiences
* Solid expertise in information architecture, navigation systems, and experience frameworks
* Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and drive alignment across teams
* Demonstrated solid communication, facilitation, and storytelling skills, including presenting to senior leadership

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience working with Adobe Experience Manager (AEM)
* Experience working with Agile teams including planning to support roadmaps, capacity, and sprint planning
* Experience working in a large corporate environment
* Experience designing accessible experiences that align with WCAG 2.1AA requirements
* Experience using AI-enabled tools to improve research, design exploration, documentation, or product design workflows
* Healthcare experience. Experience designing products in similarly complex or regulated industries including insurance, financial services, retail, telecommunications, life sciences, pharmaceuticals, or enterprise software
* Proven bias toward action and innovative big-picture thinking while improving processes and optimizing operations
* Proven willingness to learn, pivot and grow
* Proven track record of driving change in a large, complex matrixed environment even amid ambiguous circumstances
* Proven excellent resource management skills
* Proven ability to foster collaboration and build relationships with individuals on and outside of your direct team
* Proven ability to drive alignment with team members and business leaders across all initiative phases, including achieving clarity on scope and deliverables

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

description:

**Industry:** Digital Marketing Agency

* Experience creating **digital marketing and social media creatives**.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects.
* Strong attention to detail and a good sense of aesthetics.
* Ability to meet deadlines consistently.

Preferred

* Strong portfolio showcasing digital marketing and social media creatives.

Ideal Candidate

A self-motivated and creative designer who can **quickly understand briefs, bring fresh ideas, work independently, and deliver high-quality brand creatives within deadlines**.

Benefits:

* Food provided

title: Principal Designer - BIM (Structures)
description:
**Company Description**

**Work with Us. Change the World.**

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description**

**The Principal Designer** assists the Associate/BIM Manager as a project team member, interacting with project architects & engineers to develop and analyses the virtual construction process to maximize construction/coordination efficiency, job cost savings, as well as enhance project documentation & delivery.

* Minimum 10-15 years project experience using BIM60/Revit Structure environment, with duties as a lead coordinator–Engineer, or equivalent.
* Must be able to demonstrate an intermediate to advanced level of knowledge and understanding of construction methods, processes, and systems.
* Must have knowledge and understanding of common construction terminology and nomenclature as well as various building types and systems.
* Experience in Infrastructure Projects like: Metros/Airports add more advantages.
* Must be able to demonstrate an intermediate to advanced working knowledge and experience with the following software applications as well as typically used terminology, standards, and practices Revit, Navisworks, AutoCAD, BIM 360, RC CAD, Bentley Products, etc.

  
**Qualifications**  

* Diploma (or equivalent education) in an appropriate engineering discipline from an accredited college, institute or university.
* Candidate should be having minimum 15+ years of relevant experience in Managing Large scale

  
**Additional Information**

**At AECOM, you will have freedom to grow in a world of opportunity**

*Our Freedom to Grow hybrid working philosophy is the cornerstone of our success as a business – supporting a culture of flexibility, trust and performance at AECOM.*

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.***

**About AECOM**

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

**What makes AECOM a great place to work**

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community - where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Graphic Designer (Consultant)\-2

The Services team is a key differentiator for Mastercard, providing the cutting\-edge services that help our customers grow. Centered on data\-driven technologies and innovation, this team provides consulting, marketing, loyalty and analytics to financial institutions and merchants globally. Marketing Services is the team within Services that develops and executes the marketing programs that help our clients achieve their marketing goals. The Advisors Creative Desk sits within Services and is responsible for ideating and creating engaging, forward\-thinking, on\-brand content solutions that connect our advertising partners, platforms, and our portfolio of brands.  

  

  

  

  

As a Graphic Designer you will have a creative flair, relish working in a fast\-paced environment and be able to manage multiple project deliverables. You will be part a diverse team supporting clients across Asia Pacific in various verticals, so an ability to pivot from one brand to the next is critical. An interest in exploring new programs and tools, such as GenAI to improve work efficiencies and quality is a plus, as is exposure to UX/UI strategy and creative execution.  

  

  

  

  

  

  

ROLE

* Maintain quality, accuracy and consistency of content and design across all mediums to best industry practice standards and client branding guidelines by ensuring all output is checked and errors minimised.
* Overall responsibility for the production of communications material on time and to budget.
* Presentation of brand creative concepts to marketing teams, this includes – all consumer advertising for print, press, magazines, agents and all other printed comms.

\- Email / banner design \- ability to produce graphical design elements \- Adobe Creative Cloud
  

* Produce creative guidelines to ensure consistency of brand and creative across all mediums.
* Optimising graphic elements/image resizing
* Supporting Social Media efforts in particular content research and creation, monitoring and moderating followers' interactions, response creation

  

  

  

ALL ABOUT YOU
  

  

Proficiency with Figma and Adobe Creative Suite i.e Photoshop, Dreamweaver, illustrator and InDesign
  

  

Interest, and ideally experience with Generative AI
  

  

Strong portfolio of design work, showing solution to business problems through effective design
  

  

Understanding and experience in UX based email design and UI design standards
  

  

Experience executing campaigns in social media channels (ie facebook, Instagram, Youtube, TikTok)
  

  

Bachelor degree qualified, with post graduate qualifications in creative or digital marketing

title: Interior Designer 3D
description:
Job Summary:

We are seeking a skilled Interior Designer with a strong background in residential projects to join ourteam. The ideal candidate should be proficient in AutoCAD, 3D Max, Photoshop, and MS Word. Therole involves creating functional and aesthetically pleasing interior spaces that meet clients' needsand preferences.

Key Responsibilities:

 Collaborate closely with clients to understand their design preferences and requirements.

 Develop detailed interior design plans and technical drawings using AutoCAD.

 Prepare comprehensive project proposals, mood boards, and design presentations utilizingMS Word.

 Curate and recommend suitable materials, furnishings, and decor items that complementthe design aesthetic.

 Coordinate with architects, contractors, and other professionals to ensure seamless projectimplementation.

 Manage project timelines and budgets while maintaining high standards of quality and clientsatisfaction.

 Stay updated on current trends, materials, and best practices in interior design.

title: Lead UX Designer
description:
**About this role**
-------------------

  

We’re looking for a **Lead UX Designer who is AI\-forward and excited about growing business\-critical product lines while achieving a high bar for ease of use for our customers.** This is a unique opportunity for a customer\-obsessed UX and Customer Experience designer to help shape product innovation through research, design, experimentation, and rapid prototyping.


In this role, you will help design UX and product innovations while applying lean product principles in everything you do. You will use modern AI tools to accelerate ideation, explore design concepts, create prototypes, and validate product experiences while maintaining strong human\-centered design principles, quality, accessibility, and usability standards.


This position involves leveraging insights from user research, interviews, and surveys and translating them into data\-grounded design solutions, including sitemaps, user flows, customer journey maps, wireframes, mockups, and prototypes. You will conduct usability research and testing to evaluate and shape your interactions, workflows, and overall product experience. You will also be expected to design the overall functionality of the product and iterate based on research findings, user feedback, and validated learning.


Having a strong goal orientation, rather than a task orientation, and anchoring decisions in the client experience will help you navigate the challenges involved in building great products.  



  

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Translate concepts into user flows, wireframes, mockups, and prototypes that lead to intuitive user experiences.
* Leverage insights from user research, interviews, and surveys to develop data\-grounded UX solutions.
* Conduct usability research and testing to shape interaction design, validate workflows, and improve the overall user experience.
* Translate research findings into user flows, wireframes, mockups, prototypes, and other design artifacts that address user needs and business goals.
* Apply an AI\-forward design approach by using AI tools to rapidly explore concepts, generate design variations, test ideas, and develop high\-fidelity prototypes.
* Create AI\-assisted prototypes that communicate product vision, demonstrate workflows, and enable early validation with users, stakeholders, and development teams.
* Design and deliver wireframes, user stories, user journeys, reusable UX components, front\-end libraries, and mockups optimized for a wide range of devices and interfaces.
* Identify design problems and devise elegant solutions based on a user\-centered design approach; rapidly test and iterate designs based on business requirements and customer feedback.
* Create graphics and web layouts that highlight important insights, clarify complex data, and create a narrative flow to maximize user impact.
* Implement a lean approach to product development in which you and the team strive for early validated learning that leads to shorter cycle times and faster delivery of customer value.
* Partner closely with product managers, engineers, researchers, content designers, and other stakeholders to define and deliver cohesive product experiences.
* Evaluate and incorporate emerging AI capabilities into the design process and product experience, ensuring that AI\-enabled solutions are useful, understandable, inclusive, and aligned with user needs.
* Support multiple long\- and short\-term projects while actively prioritizing workflow based on ROI and business value generated.
Contribute to and evolve design systems, patterns, and best practices across products and experiences.  
* 

  

**What you’ll need**
--------------------

* Degree in a related discipline with 7\+ years of experience in product or UI design solutions based in fully digital environments.
* An AI\-forward mindset and demonstrated experience using AI tools for UX ideation, design exploration, workflow development, and rapid prototyping.
* Proficiency in using AI\-powered design and prototyping tools to create, iterate, and communicate product concepts efficiently.
* A strong understanding of basic front end development and feasibilities.
* A solid grasp of user\-centered design, human\-computer interaction, planning and conducting user research, usability research, user testing, A/B testing, rapid prototyping, heuristic analysis, usability, and accessibility.
* Ability to work with geographically distributed teams to understand detailed requirements and design user experiences that meet client needs and business objectives.
* Strong visual design, brand, and user experience instincts, with the ability to iterate designs and solutions efficiently and intelligently.
* Ability to clearly and effectively communicate design processes, ideas, and solutions to teams and clients.
* Ability to balance AI\-assisted design workflows with sound UX judgment, critical thinking, ethical considerations, and human\-centered decision\-making.
* Experience designing or prototyping AI\-enabled experiences, conversational interfaces, intelligent workflows, or data\-informed product experiences is a plus.
Be passionate about resolving user pain points through great design, innovation, and emerging technology.  
* 

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

In addition to an outstanding work environment with rapid advancement potential, Gartner associates enjoy exceptional compensation and benefits, including:


* Competitive base salary
* Flexible work environment
* A great work culture

**Who are we?**

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.


Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission\-critical priorities.


Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in \~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.


**What makes Gartner a great place to work?**

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.


We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.


Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.


We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.


**Gartner is the world authority on AI**

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.


It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.


**What do we offer?**

Gartner offers world\-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.


In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.


Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.
